assessment_summary: Step 0016 tests the wrong comparison. For Master-theorem case 1 with ε=0.5, one would need 10 log m = O(m^{-0.5}), but the displayed limit instead shows log m = o(m^{0.5}). Thus the conclusion in step 0018 does not follow. In fact, S(m)=S(m/2)+10 log m gives S(m)=Θ((log m)^2), hence T(n)=Θ((log log n)^2) under the usual base-case assumptions.
